exposure: Plasma exosomal miRNA expression profile (miR-423-5p, miR-122-5p, miR-148a-3p, miR-192-5p, miR-99a-5p)
cohort: The study included pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and pregnant women with normal glucose tolerance (NGT).
finding: Dysregulated exosomal miRNAs in plasma from pregnant women with GDM were identified, which might influence insulin and AMPK signaling pathways and could contribute to the early prediction of GDM.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, for early prediction of GDM
